about: Leonida Legend v2 — offline guide and tracker. Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them; every guide is written in our own words and cites its source beside it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the Platinum: it unlocks on its own the instant the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task for it. Follow the five-stage roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and finally the 100% cleanup — and it pops at the end.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end and it unlocks as the mission closes. Just follow the intro the way the game teaches it — no side goal is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy: work through every mission of Chapter 1 and it unlocks when the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the Lucia balcony meditation — it feeds the one missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude) and is reported to vanish after this chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 2 and it unlocks at the chapter's close. By now Jason and Lucia are both playable, which is when most of the open world opens up — use the breathing room between missions to start activities and collectibles early.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 3 and it unlocks when the chapter closes. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter — the game is reported to have no mission replay, so a save is your only way back if you want to redo anything.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 4 and it unlocks at the chapter's end. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so before you push on, sweep up anything chapter-gated you have been putting off.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy: complete the final mission and it unlocks. Make a manual save before you start it — with no mission replay reported, that save is the only way to revisit the finale or try a different choice.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks at the mission's end. Named-mission trophies like this one are awarded for finishing the mission, not for any bonus objective — just play it through.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission The Cartel Heist and it unlocks. Heist missions are story beats, so play the mission to its end — no extra objective is required for the trophy itself.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Child's Play and it unlocks. As with the other named-mission trophies, it is awarded for completing the mission, not for a perfect run — finish it however you can.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Headliners and it unlocks. The name suggests a showpiece mission, but the trophy only asks for completion — play the mission to its end and it pops.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport and it unlocks. It also introduces the airport as a location, which matters later for the unscheduled-departure trophy (Catch Me If You Can).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory and it unlocks. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies, so by the time it pops you should have all 13 story trophies in hand.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold, and the real endgame grind: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. That checklist is reported to cover story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and more — so treat it as the last trophy to chase, and use the game's own completion screen to find whatever you have left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver: pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the running total, and the game tracks it cumulatively, so every stunt you do from the first hour onward adds up. Drive aggressively on purpose between missions and the count climbs without a dedicated grind.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of every activity type — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and the rest — and it pops once the last type is sampled. It is a sampler, not a mastery trophy: one go at each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver, and one of the hardest skill trophies: earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through one weapon class at a time, learn each challenge's scoring before chasing gold, and leave this for a dedicated session rather than squeezing it between missions.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates before racing for the win — a clean line beats raw speed — and tick locations off one at a time so you can see which ones are left.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix road races, off-road and water events as you find them, and use the best vehicle class for each event instead of forcing one favourite car everywhere.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal Hampton in a fishing challenge. Cal is one of the named characters Rockstar introduced with Trailer 2, so expect this to come through his strand — take the fishing challenge when it is offered and out-fish him rather than rushing the catch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Arcades are scattered around Leonida — pick the game that suits you, learn its loop in a practice run, then play a full game to completion.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Stranger-style mission strands build up over several meetings — keep answering Andy's calls and visiting his marker whenever it appears until the strand's final mission unlocks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. As with the other stranger finals, the strand only advances when you show up for each of Kenton's missions in turn — don't leave a mission sitting unplayed for long stretches.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy's strand closes the same way as Andy's and Kenton's: play each of his missions as they appear until the final one pops this trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver: complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) are six of them — find two more stranger givers out in the state and finish their strands too.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy is one of the stranger-strand givers — follow his missions in order until the strand's final mission pops this trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's strand works like the others: each mission unlocks the next, so return to his marker whenever it lights up instead of letting the strand stall.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only trophy two sources flag as possibly missable. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, and do the Lucia balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before that chapter ends, because it is reported to disappear afterwards. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: the game is reported to have no mission replay, so a missed spot may mean a new playthrough.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. This is a stranger-strand final, so work through Bret's missions until the hunt is offered, then track the animal patiently — a rushed shot can spook it and waste the attempt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver: complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect them as you explore rather than hunting them all at once, and keep a checklist of which sets are still missing cards.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. This is a pure coverage grind — visit new districts as the story takes you there and WAiNK at every spot you pass instead of saving it all for the end.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives layered over normal play — stunts, combat feats, driving goals — so they accumulate while you work on everything else; check the challenge list now and then to steer toward the ones nearly done.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and escape until the heat dies down. Use the countryside or water to break pursuit — tight city streets keep the police on you longer.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the trick is keeping the wanted level alive between robberies, so move fast between nearby shops and don't let the heat cool off.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new car, bike, boat or aircraft you sit in counts — so drive everything you see instead of sticking to one favourite, and the count grows naturally as you explore.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a clustered group, trigger Combat Focus when they bunch up, and keep firing until the fifth drops — spreading your shots across separate fights won't count.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — grab a plane and take off without following the airport's script. The trophy's joke is the method: don't queue, don't wait for clearance, just go.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhino tanks, and the exact trigger is not spelled out by the official list — so this one is [unverified]: expect it to involve driving or surviving in a Rhino tank. Try a Rhino in open ground first, where you can experiment without the police boxing you in.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take what you need and leave before any alarm — a loud approach fails the trophy even if the robbery succeeds.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car parked close, a route out of the city — because the escape is what the trophy counts, not just the robbery.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, crack it open, then lose the heat before the trophy counts it. A getaway car staged nearby turns a scramble into a clean exit.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The state covers Vice City plus the Keys, wetlands, farmland and coast (Rockstar Trailer 2 named six regions), so this is a map-completion grind: sweep the map district by district and watch the area counter.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Learn which operation belongs to which gang before you hit it — robbing two operations of the same gang wastes a run and doesn't advance the count.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. Ocean Beach is the beachfront strip of Vice City — find a bar there, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view; it is a small breather trophy between bigger grinds.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic GTA style — drive straight through the glass and out onto the street. The trophy's joke is the method: don't use the door, use the window.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end of the game. Bowling is one of the activity types for Master of None, so this trophy and that one can progress together.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description gives no concrete step — just a partnership with mass appeal — so the exact trigger is [unverified]. The likeliest reading is a co-op moment with your partner that the game rates highly; treat any shared-activity high score as a candidate and check community reports as they land.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The PSN-tracked count for this trophy is 500 actions — every choice that moves your criminal profile counts, so it builds up across a whole playthrough rather than in one session.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description hints at succeeding on a second try, but the official list names no activity — so the exact trigger is [unverified]. The likeliest reading is retrying something that failed once and passing it on the next attempt; keep this one in mind whenever a retry pops.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description suggests witnessing something strange, but the official list names no event — so the exact trigger is [unverified]. The likeliest reading is a rare world event or easter egg encounter; explore odd corners of Leonida and note anything out of the ordinary.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Line the target up from the passenger side, time the swing as you pass, and keep the speed low enough to aim.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — feed them through your laundering contacts steadily instead of letting them pile up, and the total climbs alongside your robbery trophies.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Normal spending on weapons, clothes, cars and supplies counts toward it — don't force it early, just buy what your playthrough needs and the total will follow.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are properties you purchase, so save up and buy them as you find them — they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you are collecting for Whip It Good.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — ten different vehicles, so use the variety you are already discovering for Whip It Good.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles; GamesRadar+ / Press Start / PC Gamer
